name: Tracking Alpha
summary: Pre-launch tool for discovering and following US cash merger-arbitrage deals, with sourced updates, deadlines and scenario calculations. Waitlist open.

name: MarketStory
summary: MarketStory tracks what 2,000+ investors post on YouTube and X and organises it by stock: a bull and bear case for each stock, a sentiment timeline that marks when investor chatter shifts, and each investor’s repeated picks. Stock pages and the latest shifts are free; tracking and email reports are paid.
